title: Preserve a corrected conditional-separability null with private controls around an unknown detector
statement: Trusted private local randomization earns initial conditional separability and preserves an operational witness null for an unknown joint qubit detector, with explicit source-detector restrictions and an acquired synthetic supermartingale test.

evidence.quote: 5. Earning a discovery interface without a pure reset or detector calibration
evidence.range_scope: Complete RENDERED visible preparation/detector contract, corrected source-detector loophole and previously missing full synthetic experiment. Mathematical accessibility duplication retained literally.

evidence.quote: 7. What this adds over the strongest applicable approaches
evidence.range_scope: Complete rendered ending: strongest matched comparisons, no superior estimator/priority claim, exact model and operational scope.

requires: Known qubit structure,trusted local preparation/analysis controls and private fresh random choices unavailable through a separate side channel. Detector POVM may be joint,coherent,correlated and history dependent under the declared current-choice contract.

For a reduced-source claim require source-detector independence conditional on observed past. With shared classical flags,the null must require source FULL separability conditional on EVERY flag. No initial source-detector entanglement alone is insufficient.

Discard independent local Z-phase keys permanently before subsequent evolution;they must not be recovered to undo the preparation. Local rotations preserve the resulting initial conditional product-mixture property. This is not a pure reset or guaranteed polarization.
provides: Terminal private X^r Z^s frames and XOR decoding give unknown convolution p(z xor x). No detector inversion is required. Formal statistics map Psi_p=sum_e p(e) tensor_i T_ei,withT0=id andT1(A)=Tr(A)I-A,is positive on separable products;T1 is not completely positive and the map need not be positive on entangled states. It is a NULL-preserving representation,not channel tomography.

A classical flag labeling four Bell components can make a decoded witness-1/8 although the reduced source is maximally mixed. The corrected conditional null,not merely absence of source-detector entanglement,is essential.

Reported10-qubit synthetic run:50000 pilot+200000 fresh validation records;freeze rational-PSD-repaired witness,setting probabilities andbetting parameter before validation. Mean score-0.0266688097160823;exact lower log evidence34.12743041982046,or12.716065663841833 with0.01 systematic score allowance. Both exceed7,so significance is below0.001 under the stated conditional null.
assumptions: This is a nonnegative test supermartingale frequentist error guarantee,not a posterior probability of entanglement. Unknown detector response can erase all power.
The0.01 allowance uses a sufficient external per-trial TV perturbation bound about1.246e-3;records andaverage gate fidelity do not establish it.
The same-moment covariance SDP can produce the same kind of witness. Measurement-device-independent witnesses have different trusted-input/device contracts;no general superiority is claimed.
costs: 250000 source copies,2.5million decoded spin bits,5million terminal Pauli random bits and2.5million discarded preparation bits if physically implemented. Dense witness scoring O(n^2) per copy. In the simulator,preparation randomization was analytically marginalized;no physical gates executed.
contract.units: Conditional separability versus reduced-source separability;raw records/private labels;log evidence,systematic score andper-trial TV controls.
contract.obstruction: The structural theorem assumes finite-dimensional parties, one nonconstant local Hermitian observable per party, commuting bilinear interactions and correlated Markovian dephasing. It does not cover arbitrary Lindbladians, noncommuting local operator families, non-Markovian mediators or unbounded target observables. The coefficient-based SDP and raw-record test have different access contracts. Trusted local controls, known qubit structure, private randomization, corrected source-detector conditions and physical preparation resources remain necessary. Unknown detector response can erase power. No exact polynomial-bit decision near an ill-conditioned SDP boundary, estimator advantage over the same-moment covariance SDP or general dominance over measurement-device-independent witnesses is claimed.

body: The learner receives no Hamiltonian,Lindblad coefficients or detector model. This acquired test is distinct from the coefficient-based classification. Synthetic records/exact certificates/replay are reported,not acquired or rerun under the hold.
